liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: Douai, Bibliothèque municipale, MS 67 (formerly 94/6), from Marchiennes
liebermann.notes: A 12th-century pontifical, described at Marchiennes in the 18th century as a gift of Thomas Becket, copied from an English text of the late 11th century; it contains the Sacramentum coronationis and Iudicium Dei X and XIV, and also an Iudicium ferri.

entries.text_de: In Marchiennes im 18. Jh. bezeichnet als Geschenk Thomas Becket’s, jetzt Douai 67 (früher 94/6), Pontifical4 12. Jhs. mit Sacr cor, copirt aus Englischem Text Ende 11. Jhs.5, der in der Litanei Oswald, Swithin, Æthelwold, Ætheldreda erwähnt. Darin Iud Dei X. XIV, u. S. 417. 425 und auch Iudicium ferri.
entries.text_en: At Marchiennes in the 18th century described as a gift of Thomas Becket, now Douai 67 (formerly 94/6), pontifical4 of the 12th century with Sacr cor, copied from an English text of the end of the 11th century5, which mentions Oswald, Swithin, Æthelwold, Ætheldreda in the litany. In it Iud Dei X. XIV, below, pp. 417. 425, and also Iudicium ferri.

notes.text_de: vgl. Martène et Durand Voyage littér. de 2 Bénédictins 92; Martène Ant. eccl. rit. II 23; III 476. 199; Henderson Lib. pontif. Ebor. p. xx. 267; Zeumer Formulae 634. 714. 717. 720. Ich benutzte Bethmann’s Abschrift für Mon. Germ.
notes.text_en: cf. Martène et Durand, Voyage littér. de 2 Bénédictins 92; Martène, Ant. eccl. rit. II 23; III 476. 199; Henderson, Lib. pontif. Ebor. p. xx. 267; Zeumer, Formulae 634. 714. 717. 720. I used Bethmann’s transcript for the Mon. Germ.

notes.text_de: Aber nicht ‘early Anglo-Saxon’, wie Rock Pontif. of Egbert. p. xi meint.
notes.text_en: But not ‘early Anglo-Saxon’, as Rock, Pontif. of Egbert. p. xi, thinks.

transcription.doubts: FOOTNOTE MARK 4: no superscript 4 is printed in the text (confirmed at 600 dpi: after 'Pontifical' there is only a small low dot, a dropped or broken superscript). <sup>4</sup> placed after 'Pontifical', where the dot stands, since note 4 must fall between marks 3 (heading) and 5.
proof_notes: checked, no changes (missing mark 4 confirmed at 600 dpi; doubt reworded)
